products.name: Royal Banarasi Silk Saree — Deep Maroon
products.shortDescription: Handwoven Banarasi silk saree with rich gold zari brocade and a contrast pallu.
products.description: Woven on traditional handlooms by master artisans in the Banaras-to-Bengal weaving tradition, this pure silk saree carries dense gold zari brocade across the body and an opulent contrast pallu. The deep maroon ground is dyed for richness and the zari catches light beautifully under evening wear. Comes with an unstitched matching blouse piece. Dry clean only; store wrapped in muslin.

products.name: Banarasi Katan Silk Saree — Ivory Gold
products.shortDescription: Pure Katan silk Banarasi saree in ivory with all-over gold zari buti and a broad border.
products.description: Handwoven in pure Katan silk by Banarasi weavers, this ivory saree is patterned with delicate all-over gold zari buti and finished with a broad ornamental border and a richly woven pallu. Katan's tightly twisted silk yarn gives the drape its crisp body and lasting sheen, making it a timeless choice for weddings and receptions. Includes an unstitched matching blouse piece. Dry clean only; rest the saree between wears and store wrapped in muslin.

products.shortDescription: Lightweight Banarasi georgette silk saree in wine with scattered zari motifs.
products.description: Woven on Banarasi handlooms in soft georgette silk, this wine saree drapes light and fluid while keeping the city's signature zari craft across scattered floral motifs and a woven border. The georgette base makes it an easy, graceful choice for evening functions and festive gatherings where you want shine without weight. Comes with an unstitched matching blouse piece. Dry clean recommended.

products.shortDescription: Textured wild Tussar (Kosa) silk saree with a natural golden sheen and hand-block pallu.
products.description: Handwoven in eastern India from wild Tussar (Kosa) silk, this saree has the fabric's signature slubby texture and warm golden lustre. The pallu carries a subtle hand-block motif and the border is finished with a fine zari line. A versatile drape for day functions and the festive season. Includes an unstitched blouse piece. Dry clean recommended.

products.name: Tussar Ghicha Silk Saree — Ochre
products.shortDescription: Tussar Ghicha silk saree in ochre with a coarse, organic texture and temple-line border.
products.description: Woven from Ghicha yarn — spun from the broken filaments of Tussar cocoons — this ochre saree has a wonderfully coarse, organic texture that sets it apart from smoother silks. Artisans in eastern India finish it with a fine temple-line border and a textured pallu. An understated handloom drape for daytime celebrations and office-festive wear. Includes an unstitched blouse piece. Dry clean recommended.
products.metaTitle: Tussar Ghicha Silk Saree — Ochre | Meghali's Silk
products.metaDescription: Textured Tussar Ghicha silk saree in ochre, handwoven in eastern India. Authentic handloom from Meghali's Silk.

products.name: Pure Tussar Silk Saree — Indigo Block Print
products.shortDescription: Pure Tussar silk saree with hand block-printed indigo motifs and a natural sheen.
products.description: This pure Tussar silk saree pairs the fabric's warm natural sheen with hand block-printed indigo motifs, each impression carrying the gentle irregularity of artisan printing. The grounding indigo against Tussar's golden base makes for a striking, contemporary handloom drape. Light to carry and easy to style for festive afternoons. Includes an unstitched blouse piece. Dry clean recommended; first wash may release minor natural-dye colour.
products.metaTitle: Pure Tussar Silk Saree — Indigo Block Print | Meghali's Silk

products.name: Kanjivaram Pure Silk Saree — Peacock Blue
products.shortDescription: Pure Kanjivaram silk saree in peacock blue with a contrast mustard border and zari pallu.
products.description: Handwoven in the South Indian Kanjivaram tradition from pure mulberry silk and tested zari, this saree sets a lustrous peacock-blue body against a contrast mustard border woven in the characteristic interlocked-weft technique that gives Kanjivaram its weight and durability. The pallu carries a temple-and-floral zari composition meant to be passed down generations. A heirloom-grade drape for weddings and grand occasions. Includes an unstitched matching blouse piece. Dry clean only; store wrapped in muslin.
products.metaTitle: Kanjivaram Pure Silk Saree — Peacock Blue | Meghali's Silk
products.metaDescription: Pure Kanjivaram silk saree in peacock blue with contrast border and zari pallu. Authentic handloom from Meghali's Silk.

products.name: Kanjivaram Bridal Silk Saree — Rani Pink
products.shortDescription: Bridal Kanjivaram silk saree in rani pink with a wide contrast red zari border and grand pallu.
products.description: A bridal-grade Kanjivaram handwoven from pure mulberry silk, this rani pink saree carries a wide contrast red border and a grand zari pallu dense with temple and peacock motifs. The interlocked korvai border and heavy zari give it the heirloom weight brides look for, and the colour is dyed deep for the mandap and the camera alike. Includes an unstitched matching blouse piece. Dry clean only; store flat, wrapped in muslin, and refold along new lines periodically.
products.metaTitle: Kanjivaram Bridal Silk Saree — Rani Pink | Meghali's Silk
products.metaDescription: Bridal Kanjivaram silk saree in rani pink with contrast red zari border. Authentic handloom from Meghali's Silk.

products.shortDescription: Kanjivaram silk saree in mustard with a classic zari temple (gopuram) border and green pallu.
products.description: This mustard Kanjivaram is handwoven in pure silk with the classic gopuram-inspired temple border in gold zari that gives South Indian sarees their devotional character, set against a contrast green pallu. The body's fine zari checks and the firm Kanjivaram drape make it equally at home at temple ceremonies and festive evenings. Includes an unstitched matching blouse piece. Dry clean only; store wrapped in muslin.

products.name: Mulberry Silk Saree — Classic Red
products.shortDescription: Pure mulberry silk saree in classic red with a smooth lustrous finish and zari border.
products.description: Woven from pure mulberry silk — the finest and most lustrous of cultivated silks — this classic red saree has a smooth, fluid drape and a soft natural shine that needs little ornament. A slim gold zari border and a lightly woven pallu keep it elegant and versatile, equally suited to pujas, family functions and festive evenings. Includes an unstitched matching blouse piece. Dry clean recommended; store wrapped in muslin.

products.shortDescription: Pure mulberry silk saree in pastel mint with a fine silver-zari border for daytime elegance.
products.description: A softer take on pure mulberry silk, this pastel mint saree pairs the fabric's natural sheen with a calm, contemporary palette and a fine silver-zari border. The fluid drape and muted tone make it an elegant choice for daytime weddings, mehendi mornings and brunch receptions. Includes an unstitched matching blouse piece. products.name: Eri Silk Saree — Earthy Beige
products.shortDescription: Handwoven Eri (Ahimsa) silk saree in earthy beige with a soft, warm matte texture.
products.description: Handwoven from Eri silk — known as Ahimsa or peace silk because it is harvested without harming the silkworm — this earthy beige saree has a soft, warm, almost wool-like matte texture rather than a high gloss. Naturally insulating and exceptionally comfortable, it is an honest, sustainable handloom drape for everyday festivity and the cooler months. Includes an unstitched matching blouse piece. Dry clean or gentle hand wash recommended.

products.metaDescription: Handwoven Eri (Ahimsa) silk saree in earthy beige with a soft matte texture. Authentic handloom from Meghali's Silk.

products.shortDescription: Eri silk saree in charcoal with woven olive stripes and a soft, matte handloom feel.
products.description: This charcoal Eri silk saree is handwoven with subtle olive stripes along the body and pallu, the muted palette letting the fabric's natural matte texture lead. Like all Eri, it is soft, warm and breathable — an understated, contemporary handloom drape for work-festive days and cooler evenings. Includes an unstitched matching blouse piece. products.name: Muga Silk Saree — Assam Golden
products.shortDescription: Rare Assam Muga silk saree with the fabric's natural, untreated golden glow.
products.description: Handwoven in Assam from rare Muga silk, this saree carries the fibre's famous natural golden glow — a lustre that is never dyed and is said to deepen with every wash and year. Prized for its strength and sheen, Muga is among the most exclusive silks in the world and is woven here in the traditional Assamese idiom with a fine zari border. An heirloom drape for the most special occasions. Includes an unstitched matching blouse piece. Dry clean only; store wrapped in muslin.

products.metaDescription: Rare Assam Muga silk saree with a natural golden glow. Authentic handloom from Meghali's Silk.

products.shortDescription: Assam Muga silk saree in natural gold with a striking woven red border and pallu.
products.description: This Assam Muga silk saree sets the fibre's untreated golden lustre against a striking woven red border and a matching pallu, a classic Assamese pairing that reads rich and celebratory. Muga's renowned durability and growing sheen make it a true keep-forever piece, handwoven by Assam's weaving families. Ideal for weddings, Bihu and grand festive occasions. Includes an unstitched matching blouse piece. Dry clean only; store wrapped in muslin.

products.name: Baluchari Silk Saree — Maroon Narrative Pallu
products.shortDescription: Bengal Baluchari silk saree in maroon with a narrative figured pallu of woven mythological scenes.
products.description: Handwoven in the Baluchari tradition of Bengal, this maroon saree is distinguished by its narrative pallu — panels of figured silk depicting mythological and courtly scenes rendered entirely in the weave, a craft once centred at Murshidabad and revived in Bishnupur. The contrast cream pallu and intricate borders make it a connoisseur's drape for cultural evenings and weddings. Includes an unstitched matching blouse piece. Dry clean only; store wrapped in muslin.

products.metaDescription: Bengal Baluchari silk saree in maroon with a narrative figured pallu. Authentic handloom from Meghali's Silk.

products.shortDescription: Bengal Baluchari silk saree in midnight blue with gold-toned figured motifs and pallu.
products.description: This midnight blue Baluchari is handwoven in Bengal with gold-toned figured motifs across the border and a richly storied pallu, the deep blue ground giving the woven artwork a luminous, jewel-like contrast. Carrying forward the Bishnupur revival of this once-royal craft, it is a refined drape for soirees, cultural functions and festive evenings. Includes an unstitched matching blouse piece. Dry clean only; store wrapped in muslin.

products.metaDescription: Bengal Baluchari silk saree in midnight blue with gold-toned figured motifs. Authentic handloom from Meghali's Silk.

products.name: Bengal Handloom Silk Saree — Dhakai Jamdani
products.shortDescription: Bengal handloom silk-blend saree in the Dhakai Jamdani tradition with airy woven motifs.
products.description: Handwoven in the Dhakai Jamdani tradition shared across Bengal, this lightweight silk-blend saree carries the technique's hallmark — discontinuous supplementary-weft motifs that appear to float on a sheer, breathable ground, each one inlaid by hand at the loom. An everyday-festive drape that is feather-light to wear and endlessly versatile. Includes an unstitched matching blouse piece. Gentle hand wash or dry clean; line dry in shade.
